featured_reviews.name: Michelle Yang
featured_reviews.review_text:
Started the course on 6th April 26, and just passed my driving test 25th May 26. Everything from start to finish was efficiently managed. You just need to walk in with ur aadhar card number and mobile to register. They will take the picture, they will make the LL. Brownie point they ve standby cars ready incase the AC broke down or a previous student damaged the car. Class always started on time and on the one instance it started late the teacher recovered it for me. I had Mohsin Sir, he’s a kind and knowledgeable teacher… all my queries were explained and feedback given at the end of class.. After 10 regular lessons I upgraded to Pro as I wanted to drive further away from Town ( 10 classes x1 hr and 2 classes x1.30hrd) it was a pleasant decision coz the routes are pre planned and included roads like the sea link and freeway.
Due to a lot of factors including RTo delays I had to  ask them twice to apply for early exam date which was only open for June … but lo and behold they called me once to ask if I could take some other applicants early spot who wished to delay..
Anyways cherry on top they have overall good management system, exam day was reminded with WhatsApp..  I had lost my MVWG LL license and realised on a Sunday the day before ..🫣… bless the team they replied at 8 in the morning of the exam and send me a pdf which I printed outside at RTO… even the exam process was smooth.. they have a team there with a car ready… I just went there got into the car took a round of the ground answered a few questions and within 25 mins was out of the RTo with My receipt.
This is my first driving license in India, I m happy with their service.. apparently while I was waiting at the centre for my class  I learnt they help with all sorts of RTO work… and they advised me for my sisters and mums license renewal ☺️
Wrote so much because I want to say genuine Thanks to Your Team, 🤞 Good Luck

3. RTO charges 100 as fine for reappearing learners test.

Especially Dilip sir, the driving instructor is so knowledgeable and good with his teaching skills that not a single session feels demotivating. He is constantly boosting your confidence, knows every tiny detail to pick on road while driving and instills the same habit. And not to forget, Dilip sir is full of humour and so chilled! I’ve picked all my confidence back again with him after long 10-12 years of a break from driving.

featured_reviews.name: PRASHANT KADAM
featured_reviews.review_text: Great experience with this driving school! The instructor was patient, professional, and explained everything clearly from basic controls to real road scenarios. The training boosted my confidence and made me feel fully prepared for driving independently. Highly recommend for anyone looking to learn safe and practical driving.

featured_reviews.name: Gopi Devender
featured_reviews.review_text: If you want to ace your driving test first go and not only that become a great driver, Happy Motors (Mr. Dilip )the guy to go to. He’s very knowledgeable when it comes to driving and has a great sense of humor. Certainly doesn’t fail to put a smile on your face each lesson. He doesn’t miss a thing when you’re on the road and is always striving to help improve each and evey aspect of your driving. Without a doubt Mr. Dilip is the best driving instructor and overall just a top bloke. I’d highly recommend him. I will rate 5 🌟 out of 5

featured_reviews.name: Mansi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Experienced and skilled professionals. Dilip sir is very patient and will guide you throughout, and explain you the rules. He will also take you through different routes and spend good time in training. Will recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Ashutosh Rao
featured_reviews.review_text: This is a good training program including 4 weekend (Sunday) theory classes in addition to the daily 30 minute driving classes. In the mechanical theory class, each participant was individually given the opportunity to replace a wheel which was very  useful. The other 3 theory classes also provided a lot of general knowledge on the rules and regulations, why they exist and common sense tips and quick decision making to prevent accidents and ensure alert and safe driving.
